name: Abigail Kirsch Named to Women's Hall of Fame - Westchester County
snippet:
Kirsch founded Abigail Kirsch Catering Relationships in 1975 following an 11-year stint as owner, chef and instructor of the Abigail Kirsch School of Cookery ...
The founder of Abigail Kirsch Catering Relationships and author of three cookbooks, she is also a dedicated role model and mentor to many women. Kirsch founded Abigail Kirsch Catering Relationships in 1975 following an 11-year stint as owner, chef and instructor of the Abigail Kirsch School of Cookery in Chappaqua.
